GhosttyKit.xcframework.tar.gz in this directory is a compiled build of Ghostty,
vendored here so the build does not depend on an external download URL.

Source: https://github.com/manaflow-ai/ghostty (a fork of https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty)
Pinned commit: fc2d507dcf4d67228e56c6d69ad9e9aa2080a6dc
SHA256: cbe4a8b5f8c00ea9ffe4274e5e764009b6efe2dc877646fd6fa12d34146ce8fe
